title: Thavha i Khou Swa
description: Thuli na khonani dzawe vha funa u tamba “Thavha i Khou Swa”. Fhedzi ḓuvha ḽiṅwe ndi musi thavha i tshi swa zwa vhukuma nahone zwimela zwoṱhe zwo nakaho zwi re thavhani zwa swa ha sala miora. Thuli na khonani dzawe vha ṱungufhala … u swika vha tshi vhona mitomba miṱuku mutswuku na midala. Hu nga vha hu mini?
subjects: Nature and looking after our planet
